findings.title: User-managed service account keys are rotated within 90 days
findings.remediation: gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new.json --iam-account=<email>; switch callers; gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete <key-id> --iam-account=<email>. Prefer Workload Identity / impersonation over keys.

findings.title: Cloud Audit Logs Data Access logging enabled for all services
findings.remediation: gcloud projects get-iam-policy <project> > p.yaml; add auditConfigs for service allServices with ADMIN_READ, DATA_READ, DATA_WRITE and no exemptedMembers; gcloud projects set-iam-policy <project> p.yaml
